changes: Removed the in-game global header, persistent explanation row and word history display; tools now live in the pause menu
Hints open on demand, close on outside tap or Escape, and reopen at the same stage without another charge
Answer presentation lasts 1600ms normally, 2200ms for alternatives/new discoveries and 2500ms for completion; tapping still skips it
Three original SVG rival appearances retain all ten moods and are deterministic by session seed/round
Added PWA manifest, 192/512/180px icons, secure-context service worker, home-screen guidance and supported fullscreen toggle

pwa.offlineClaim: Cached shell and previously viewed title pictures only; new gameplay needs connectivity

diagnostics: The opening stage check formerly read a throttled loading snapshot with no initialized board. It now pauses through the public UI to save the actual board/remaining duration before advancing its frozen clock.
Title catalog buttons include a discovery count; the menu helper now handles both that label and the compact pause-menu label.
Rival appearance checks were rerun through the instrumented page fixture so browser/resource errors are included.
The old 850ms answer and permanent hint-row assumptions in timing and hint tests were updated to the explicitly requested presentation.
limitations: Smartphone installation requires a trusted HTTPS URL; the current LAN HTTP address remains browser-only. No public HTTPS deployment or native OS installation was performed.
Physical iPhone/iPad/Android fullscreen, OS keyboard and status-bar behavior were not tested; Linux WebKit is not an iOS device.
Only cached previously viewed pictures are available without a connection; the full dictionary is not precached.
Earlier input, cold/warm and 500-round resource measurements remain bound to their previous runtime and were not rerun for this increment.
